title: malloc(0) in flash_test_make_rsa_keystore_from_der
description: flash_test_make_rsa_keystore_from_der (wp11_test_pkcs11.c ~line 1281) calls malloc(derlen) where derlen could theoretically be 0. C99 §7.22.3.4 says malloc(0) returns NULL or a unique pointer — either is implementation-defined. In practice derlen is never 0 for valid DER, but there is no guard. Options: (a) add explicit if (derlen == 0) return SKIP; at top, or (b) add a comment noting the invariant.
